description: This PHP source file defines the LDAPSyncException class within the OrangeHRM application's LDAP exception namespace. The class extends the base Exception class and provides multiple static methods that generate specific LDAP synchronization related exceptions, often incorporating constants from other classes. It serves as a specialized exception type used for error handling during LDAP synchronization processes.

classes.name: LDAPSyncException
classes.description: A custom exception class for LDAP synchronization errors, providing static factory methods for common error scenarios.

methods.name: nonUniqueWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee's work email is not unique.

methods.name: nonUniqueEmployeeId
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that the employee ID is not unique.

methods.name: userDNMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the LDAP user DN exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: usernameMinLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the username is shorter than the minimum length.

methods.name: usernameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the username exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: usernameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception when the username attribute is missing.

methods.name: firstNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception when the first name attribute is missing.

methods.name: firstNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the first name exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: middleNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the middle name exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: lastNameEmpty
methods.description: Creates an exception when the last name attribute is missing.

methods.name: lastNameMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the last name exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: employeeIdMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the employee ID exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: employeeWorkEmailMaxLength
methods.description: Creates an exception when the employee work email exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: invalidEmployeeWorkEmail
methods.description: Creates an exception for an invalid employee work email.

calls: new self('Employee work email is not a unique email')
new self('Employee ID is not a unique ID')
new self('User DN length should not exceed ' . LDAPUser::USER_DN_MAX_LENGTH . ' characters')
new self('Username length should be at least ' . UserService::USERNAME_MIN_LENGTH . ' characters')
new self('Username length should not exceed ' . UserService::USERNAME_MAX_LENGTH . ' characters')
new self('First name attribute `$firstNameAttribute` not exist')
new self('First name length should not exceed ' . EmployeeService::FIRST_NAME_MAX_LENGTH . ' characters')
new self('Middle name length should not exceed ' . EmployeeService::MIDDLE_NAME_MAX_LENGTH . ' characters')
new self('Last name attribute `$lastNameAttribute` not exist')
new self('Last name length should not exceed ' . EmployeeService::LAST_NAME_MAX_LENGTH . ' characters')
new self('Employee Id length should not exceed ' . EmployeeService::EMPLOYEE_ID_MAX_LENGTH . ' characters')
new self('Employee work email length should not exceed ' . EmployeeService::WORK_EMAIL_MAX_LENGTH . ' characters')
